ProxyEndpoint.name: default
ProxyEndpoint.Description: North-south partner front door for allowlisted Esmeralda agents (SSE and JSON routes separated).

Step.Name: RF-Key-Identity-Mismatch
Step.Condition: (verifyapikey.VAK-Verify-Partner-Key.app.owner_identity != null) and (verifyapikey.VAK-Verify-Partner-Key.app.owner_identity != "") and (request.header.x-verified-identity != null) and (request.header.x-verified-identity != "") and (verifyapikey.VAK-Verify-Partner-Key.app.owner_identity != request.header.x-verified-identity)

Flow.name: streamQuery
Flow.Description: ADK streaming reasoning engine invocation over SSE
Flow.Condition: ((proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/*:streamQuery") or (proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/*/api/stream_reasoning_engine") or (proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/*/v1/message:stream")) and (request.verb = "POST")

Flow.name: notFound
Flow.Description: Catch-all 404 for unknown paths or methods

RouteRule.name: sse
RouteRule.Condition: (((proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/*:streamQuery") or (proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/*/api/stream_reasoning_engine")) and (request.header.Accept =| "text/event-stream")) or (proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/*/v1/message:stream")
